description: Source code for the S3 Path Migration Worker in Mattermost, handling file migration jobs, claiming jobs, processing file batches, and updating job status.

classes.name: S3PathMigrationWorker
classes.description: Worker class responsible for migrating file paths in S3, managing job claiming, processing file batches, and updating job status.

methods.name: MakeWorker
methods.description: Factory function to create a new S3PathMigrationWorker instance with provided job server, store, and file backend.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the worker loop, listening for stop signals or new jobs to process.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the worker gracefully by signaling the stop channel.

methods.name: JobChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel for submitting jobs to the worker.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Checks environment variable to determine if the worker is enabled.

methods.name: getJobMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves integer metadata from a job's data map, handling errors.

methods.name: DoJob
methods.description: Main method to process a migration job, including claiming, batch processing, and updating status.

methods.name: markAsComplete
methods.description: Marks the migration as complete in the system store.

methods.name: setJobSuccess
methods.description: Updates job progress to 100% and marks it as successful.

methods.name: setJobError
methods.description: Sets an error state for the job in the job server.
